election_vote_rollups.name: election_vote_rollups
election_vote_rollups.ddl: create table election_vote_rollups (election_id text, grain text, state text, city_code text, zone text, section text, office text, office_key text, constituency text, candidate_id text, kind text, number text, votes bigint, destination text, transit text, source_url text, source_sha256 text, source_year int, source_part text)

election_votes.name: election_votes
election_votes.ddl: create table election_votes (election_id text, grain text, state text, city_code text, zone text, section text, office text, office_key text, constituency text, candidate_id text, kind text, number text, votes bigint, destination text, transit text, source_url text, source_sha256 text, source_year int, source_part text)

election_candidates.name: election_candidates
election_candidates.ddl: create table election_candidates (election_id text, state text, office text, office_key text, constituency text, candidate_id text, number text, name text, short_name text, party_number text, party text, party_name text, status text, status_code text, source_candidate_id text, source_url text, source_sha256 text, source_year int, source_part text)

candidate_attributes.name: candidate_attributes
candidate_attributes.ddl: create table candidate_attributes (election_id text, state text, office text, office_key text, constituency text, candidate_id text, number text, name text, short_name text, party_number text, party text, party_name text, source_candidate_id text, gender text, race text, education text, occupation text, age_band text, status text, status_code text, candidacy_status text, source_url text, source_sha256 text, source_year int, source_part text)

candidate_identity.name: candidate_identity
candidate_identity.ddl: create table candidate_identity (election_id text, candidate_id text, state text, office text, office_key text, source_record_id text, identity_status text, reported_constituency text, source_url text, source_sha256 text, source_member text, source_row int, source_year int, source_part text)
